data.body: S5 (5851): CI patchset 1 FAILED (20 tests: 17 review-bot worker/lifespan/retrigger over-tightened _worker/startup_binding interface + auth-guard firing via stub TypeError; 3 complexity-baseline stale after _review_and_vote extraction dropped below C901). Fixed: app.py reads startup_binding defensively + forwards runtime only when non-None (backward-compat, zero existing tests touched); regenerated complexity baseline via --update-stale (removed vanished _review_and_vote entry; --lock OK, no raised ceilings). Full default suite GREEN (13840+ passed, 0 failed) + lint + typecheck + held-out oracle 19/19. Amended 772f6b8f02, re-pushed patchset 2 to change 1861, released WIP. Awaiting re-gate.
